purpose: Continue the offline three-session research goal from Campaign122's terminal zero-candidate frontier by reviewing a finite public point-in-time source catalog and selecting at most one information state before any provider row, candidate value, comparator value, price, or return is opened.

public_documentation_observed.note: The public page documents fields and example reason tokens but does not state a point threshold on this page. Campaign123 therefore freezes semantics first and leaves entitlement unresolved until a separate acceptance plan.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: official_pure_security_rename_recency_60s
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: An exact provider-classified pure rename is a completed issuer identity and attention-reset event. It can be isolated without reading security-name text and without treating ST, ST exit, share-reform, or other status rows as renames. This is a new point-in-time source state rather than a transformation of the terminal price/minute library.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: name_text_or_alias_sentiment
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Reading or scoring security-name text would revive the explicitly rejected text-interpretation branch, add uncontrolled token choices, and risk confusing status aliases with issuer identity changes.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: st_or_st_exit_from_namechange
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: ST membership and confirmed ST exit already have an immutable terminal source history. The exact tokens ST and 撤销ST are prohibited from the selected source state rather than used as a provider substitute.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: share_reform_or_other_reason_recency
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: 完成股改, 未股改加S and 其他 describe heterogeneous status or residual categories. Combining or searching them would create post-document category selection and would not identify the same economic event.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: rename_count_frequency_or_name_duration_grid
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Counts, frequency, prior-name spell duration, multiple recency windows and direction grids introduce an unnecessary search family. Campaign123 fixes one latest-event 60-session recency definition only.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: rename_interacted_with_price_volume_board_industry_or_terminal_event
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Interactions, subsets, neutralization and combinations would reopen terminal features and expand multiplicity. The selected mechanism remains a standalone event-state definition.

selected_candidate.name: official_pure_security_rename_recency_60s
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A recently completed pure security rename can mark an issuer identity or strategic-positioning reset that attracts and diffuses attention over the following sessions; more recent accepted events are therefore ranked higher for a three-session holding diagnostic.

required_next_steps: pass a complete no-value mechanism-overlap and source-identifiability audit
implement and test a pure zero-network adapter and exact one-factor formula
freeze an entitlement-safe one-shot acceptance workflow before any provider request
